score: ML4 with the original Dijkstra weights in nanoseconds plus 6.92658480142496 nanoseconds per simulated gshare miss
definition: Use (T_solver + offset_ns) / (T_reference + offset_ns). The baseline uses zero.
derivation: For each alternative and input on each of the two literal-matching boots, solve for the score offset matching median native solver/reference CPU. Among finite positive crossings take the median, rounded to the nearest whole millisecond. Report all crossings, including the excluded negative values.
archival_transfer: Apply the fixed 7000000 ns offset to both boots of BFS grid, Fenwick range sum, Dijkstra (contest plus layered), predecessor, inversions and range-distinct. These public archives were available during method selection.
